subject: ela
intro: Use context and word parts to pick the meaning.

items.prompt:
Read.

Some animals are nocturnal, active at night.

'Nocturnal' means:
A) active at night
B) active in the day
C) always asleep

steps: Defined in text. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The desert is arid; almost no rain falls.

'Arid' means:
A) very wet
B) very dry
C) very cold

The prefix 're-' in 'rebuild' means:
A) not
B) again
C) before

Read.

The scientists observed the storm, recording every change.

'Observed' means:
A) ignored
B) watched carefully
C) caused

steps: They recorded changes. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'Biography' contains the root 'bio' (life). A biography is the story of someone's:
A) life
B) lunch
C) town

Read.

The volcano became dormant and stopped erupting for years.

'Dormant' means:
A) very active
B) inactive/resting
C) brand new

'Microscope' uses 'micro' (small) and 'scope' (to look). A microscope is a tool to:
A) look at very small things
B) measure heat
C) travel far
items.answer: A) look at very small things

solution.answer: A) look at very small things

items.prompt:
Read.

The salt dissolved in the water, spreading evenly and disappearing from view.

'Dissolved' means the salt:
A) floated on top
B) mixed in completely
C) sank in one lump

steps: Spread and disappeared. Key is B.
